summary: Completed comprehensive testing of BDM Lead Transfer feature. All functionality working correctly: Dashboard KPI shows 'Transferred to Dealer: 1', Sidebar link present, Transferred Leads page functional with Reverse button, APIs working for transfer/untransfer operations, and KPIs correctly exclude transferred leads from main counts.
passed_tests: BDM Transfer API - POST /api/leads/{id}/transfer successfully transfers BDM leads
BDM Untransfer API - POST /api/leads/{id}/untransfer successfully reverses transfers
Transferred Leads List API - GET /api/leads/transferred/list returns transferred leads
Transferred Leads Stats API - GET /api/leads/transferred/stats returns statistics
KPIs API - Correctly excludes transferred leads from main counts
KPIs API - Shows transferred_leads count separately (currently 1)
Error Handling - Non-BDM leads cannot be transferred (400 error)
Error Handling - Already transferred leads cannot be transferred again (400 error)
Error Handling - Non-transferred leads cannot be untransferred (400 error)
Error Handling - Non-existent leads return 404 error
Dashboard UI - 'Transferred to Dealer' KPI card present and shows count
Sidebar UI - 'Transferred Leads' link present and functional
Transferred Leads Page - Loads correctly with proper title and description
Transferred Leads Page - Shows leads table with transferred leads
Transferred Leads Page - Reverse button available and functional
Manage Leads Page - Loads correctly and shows leads table
Lead Transfer Exclusion - Transferred leads excluded from regular leads list
Lead Transfer Inclusion - Untransferred leads appear back in regular leads list

success_percentage.backend: 100% - All BDM transfer APIs working correctly with proper error handling
success_percentage.frontend: 100% - All UI components present and functional, transfer workflow working
